## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run build`, and relevant web/browser tests pass.
- [ ] Rust format, clippy, and `cargo test --no-default-features` pass for provider/core changes.
- [ ] New providers have a fixture/contract test and a conservative PreviewCapability.
- [ ] CSP/X-Frame-Options are not bypassed with a proxy or header rewrite.
- [ ] Chinese and English documentation are synchronized for user-facing changes.
- [ ] No private history, cookies, local paths, or personal data are included.

## Compatibility

Describe effects on provider indexing, search ranking, preview policy, WebViewer isolation, persistence, or Pages snapshots.
